subject: Intro demo & sandbox fit — volume, use cases & timing
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Interested in a live demo + sandbox access

Hi Ben —

We just spun up a sandbox via the self-serve flow and I’m the product lead here at BrightCart. Looking for a quick live demo to understand:

- Whether Redwood can support our two primary use cases (support triage + semantic search over product docs)
- How the sandbox maps to a pilot / prod setup (data isolation, token limits)
- Rough cost/throughput for our expected volume

Couple of quick details: we have ~3M product docs (mostly plain text + some HTML), expecting ~8–12M tokens/day during peak, and planning a pilot targeted for mid-November.

Available windows this week: Thu (9/16) morning EST or Fri afternoon EST. Would prefer a 30–45m slot.

Thanks — happy to coordinate with an SDR if needed.

Alex Morgan
Product Lead, BrightCart
alex.morgan@brightcart.com
+1 (617) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a live demo + sandbox access

Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run through fit and the sandbox details. Before we lock a slot, two quick qualification items so we tailor the demo: 

1) Use-case prioritization — is the primary focus customer support automation (routing & summarization) or semantic search for discovery? We’ll allocate time accordingly (model + eval tradeoffs differ).
2) Volume detail — you mentioned 8–12M tokens/day peak. Is that steady or concentrated in bursts (e.g., Black Friday spikes)? Also are those tokens from user input or embedding/indexing generation?
3) Pilot goals & timeline — mid-November as pilot start is helpful. Are there internal stakeholders (security/compliance, infra) who should join the call? Any mandatory compliance requirements (SAML/SCIM, data residency)?

I’ve cc’d Monica (our SDR) to help with calendar options. I can do Thu morning EST (9/16) at 10:00am ET for a 45m slot if that works — otherwise propose 9/17 or next week.

High level: sandbox maps quite closely to our Dedicated evaluation in terms of API surface, but we’ll cover limits and escalation paths during the demo.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in a live demo + sandbox access

Thanks Ben — answers below: 

1) Primary = semantic search for discovery (we want embeddings + reranking for product search), secondary = support triage (summarization + intent classification). So please allocate most time to embeddings/indexing and retrieval quality.
2) Volume: the 8–12M tokens/day estimate is mostly from embedding generation and subsequent retrieval traffic (user queries). We expect batch indexing of the 3M docs over 1–2 weeks initially, then ~1–2M new tokens/day after indexing. We also expect weekly spikes during marketing pushes.
3) Pilot stakeholders: Priya (cc’d) will handle infra/security questions. We do require SSO (SAML) for pilot users and audit logs retained for 6 months.

Thu 9/16 10:00am ET works for us — please send the invite. Also if you have a short pre-demo intake form we can fill out to speed the call, send that along.

Looking forward,
Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo confirmed: Thu 9/16 10:00am ET (30–45m) — intake + invite attached

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks — confirmed for Thu 9/16 at 10:00am ET for a 45-minute session. Calendar invite attached (20260917-brightcart-demo-invite.ics).

Quick asks before the call:
- Please complete this 2–3 minute intake form so we can pre-config the sandbox: https://forms.redwood.ai/demo-intake?acct=BRG-2345
- If you can, upload a representative sample doc (5–10 files) to this Drive folder so we can demo embedding quality against your content: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1example

Attachment: 20260917-brightcart-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo confirmed: Thu 9/16 10:00am ET (30–45m) — intake + invite attached

Perfect — thanks Alex and Priya. A couple of quick prep notes for our side before the call: 

- If Priya can join for the first 10 mins to confirm SSO/audit requirements that would be ideal (we can then dive into embeddings + evals).
- If you have any existing latency or throughput targets (p95 token latency, tokens-per-second) please paste them into the intake form — that helps our performance engineer scope the right config and batching/quant options.

See you on the call.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
